description:
Summarise a score and show some bars as ABC notation: title, parts with
instruments and ranges, key, meters, tempos and bar count.

bars.description: Bars to show as ABC, e.g. "1-8" (max 32); "" for none
bars.title: Bars

content.description: The score itself as text (ABC, MusicXML, MEI or Humdrum)
content.title: Content

file.description: Link to the music file: from the Scoreproof upload page, or any public https URL
file.title: File

filename.description: Name for content, with its extension (default tune.abc)
filename.title: Filename

parts.description: Parts by number (1-based) or name; default all
parts.title: Parts

name: inspect
title: Look at a score
